_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Tracks and one-off unlocks (spec section 7). TIERS: each district opens one tier of every track (tier 0 = district 1). tier_levels = levels a tier holds; tier_ratio = cost ratio from one level to the next inside that tier; tier_cost = what the first level of a tier costs for a track of weight 1 (tier 0 uses the track's own first_cost instead). Cost of a level = (first_cost in tier 0, else weight x tier_cost[tier]) x tier_ratio[tier]^(position inside the tier). TRACKS: stat = the stat it multiplies by (1 + add x level); requires = an id that must be owned; first_tier = the tier it opens in; planet_levels = levels available on this planet (the sum of tier_levels from first_tier); final_levels = where the track ends in the whole game, so later planets have tiers to add. UNLOCKS: one-off buys and grants. cost {cubes, parts}; requires = owned ids; district = index of the district that must be open; when = counters that must be reached (bales, hexes, pieces, mastery_<kind>); auto = owned the moment its conditions hold, at no cost (a find or a grant); gate = the default player saves for it; crew = only useful with robots; mods = stat multipliers; adds = stat additions; set = values set (base_level). Unlocks with no cost and no auto flag are granted by a district's source (districts.json grants).

planet_stops._doc: Where Planet 1 stops, so later planets have real things to add (DECISIONS: Planet 1 is only the beginning).
planet_stops.mastery: cap 10; only litter is expected to reach it
planet_stops.robot_types: 6; the Multibot waits for a later planet
